# 1-on-1 Physical Therapy in Barrington, IL

Physical therapy that actually listens and gets to the root cause.

At Achieve Physical Therapy, you're not a number. You're not sharing your therapist with three other patients. Every visit is 1-on-1 with Dr. Julie Johlie Roy, DPT who listens first, finds the root cause, and builds a plan around your goals. Whether you're dealing with a nagging injury, recovering from surgery, or not sure where to start we meet you where you are.

[Not Sure If You Need PT? Start with a Free Consultation →](https://intakeq.com/booking/sglmgu)

[(847) 387-3610](tel:+18473873610) [Email Us](mailto:Julie@AchievePTWellness.com)

![Recovery session at Achieve PT](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/48399c04-8c50-41b9-8651-171bf0fe3984/achieve-pt-barrington-dr-julie-roy-tmd-jaw-cervical-manual-therapy-1600w.webp?format=600w)

★★★★★

"I had an amazing experience being treated by Julie for hand and forearm pain. She is incredibly knowledgeable, attentive, and truly listens."

Tanya R. · Google Review

Free to start **20-minute injury consultation — no cost, no commitment**

Is This You?

## You might be a great fit for Achieve PT if:

- ✓You've tried PT before and it felt generic or rushed
- ✓You're dealing with pain that hasn't fully resolved
- ✓You want someone to explain the why — not just hand you a sheet of exercises
- ✓You're active and want to get back to training, sport, golf, Pilates, or hiking
- ✓You're recovering from surgery and want a clear, progressive plan
- ✓You have jaw pain, headaches, or clicking your dentist can't explain
- ✓You or a loved one is living with Parkinson's, stroke recovery, or MS

**We're not a passive, go-through-the-motions practice.**

Recovery takes partnership — and we'll coach and encourage you every step of the way. If you want someone who listens, explains everything, and genuinely invests in your progress, you're in the right place.

### Not sure where to start?

Our free 20-minute injury consultation is exactly for this. No forms. No commitment. Just a conversation about what's going on and how we can help.

[Book Free Consultation →](https://intakeq.com/booking/sglmgu) [Read common questions →](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/faqs)

Your Path to Recovery

## How It Works

A clear, transparent journey from first contact to lasting results. No guesswork. No surprises.

1

Free Injury Consultation

20 minutes · No commitment · No referral needed

We talk through what's going on, screen for red flags, and help you decide if PT is the right next step.

2

Initial Evaluation

60 minutes · $180

A thorough assessment of movement, strength, and symptoms — plus hands-on treatment and a home program you can start right away.

3

Dry Needling

30 min ($80) or 60 min ($150)

Targeted follow-ups where we build momentum, progress your plan, and track measurable milestones.

Want to save? Our treatment packages offer **5–10% off**, never expire, and can be shared with family.

What to Expect

## Your First Visit

Everything you need to know before you walk in the door.

![Injury consultation](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/077ece53-3830-4040-b158-2883b6c0ed1a/injury-consultation-1600w.webp?format=500w)

Free · 20 Minutes · No Obligation

Free Injury Consultation

Not sure if you need PT? Let's talk. We'll listen to your symptoms, screen for anything that needs medical follow-up, and recommend the best next step. No pressure, no forms, no commitment.

![Initial evaluation](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/101a51e8-a0b8-455b-bde5-a9c645c8957e/initial-evalutation-1600w.webp?format=500w)

$180 · 60 Minutes

Initial Evaluation

Dr. Julie Roy will assess your movement, strength, and symptoms — then start hands-on treatment and give you a home program you can begin right away. You'll leave with a clear plan and realistic milestones.

**Wear:** Comfortable athletic clothing

**Bring:** Any imaging, surgical notes, or symptoms timeline

**Expect:** Treatment starts on day one

How We Help

## [Our Treatment Areas](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/treatment-techniques)

Warm, human-centered care — with the clinical depth to back it up. [View all physical therapy services →](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/services)

[Orthopedic Rehab\\
\\
Neck, back, shoulder, hip, knee, ankle — from nagging aches to post-surgical recovery. We'll figure out what's actually going on and build a plan to fix it.](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/treatment-techniques/orthopedic-physical-therapy) [TMJ & Jaw Pain\\
\\
Clicking, locking, headaches from clenching. Julie has specialized training in TMJ/TMD and treats the jaw, neck, and contributing habits together.](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/treatment-techniques/tmd-tmj) [Dry Needling\\
\\
Stubborn muscle knots and tension that won't release with stretching alone. Quick, targeted, and always combined with strengthening.](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/treatment-techniques/trigger-point-dry-needling) [IASTM & Cupping\\
\\
Specialized tools detect and treat restrictions in muscles, fascia, and tendons. Cupping decompresses soft tissue to promote blood flow and reduce guarding.](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/treatment-techniques/instrument-assisted-soft-tissue-mobilization) [Joint Mobilization & Manipulation\\
\\
Hands-on techniques that restore normal joint motion and reduce pain — applied to the spine and every extremity joint during the hands-on portion of your care.](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/treatment-techniques/joint-mobilization-and-manipulation) [Neurologic Rehab\\
\\
Balance, walking, strength, and independence for people living with Parkinson's, stroke, or MS. LSVT BIG certified.](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/treatment-techniques/neurologic-physical-therapy)

![Dr. Julie Johlie Roy, DPT — Doctor of Physical Therapy, Achieve PT Barrington IL](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/67b545e99f6652611f51f560/e2658f0a-b253-4e13-b1ce-a8a979c67930/dr-julie-roy-dpt-600w.webp?format=600w)

About Your Therapist

Dr. Julie Johlie Roy, DPT

Doctor of Physical Therapy · Owner of Achieve Physical Therapy & Wellness

Julie believes in coaching and uplifting patients so each person can achieve their optimal health. She specializes in orthopedic rehab, TMJ/TMD therapy, dry needling, and neurologic rehabilitation including LSVT BIG for Parkinson's. Every session is private, 1-on-1, and inside Tensile Strength Studio — where rehab progresses from pain relief to real-life strength and confidence.

[Meet Julie →](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/about)

Or call directly: [(847) 387-3610](tel:+18473873610)

## Physical Therapy in Barrington, IL

Achieve Physical Therapy & Wellness is a private physical therapy practice at 756 W Northwest Highway, Suite B, Barrington, Illinois 60010, operated by Dr. Julie Johlie Roy, DPT. Serving Barrington, Lake Zurich, Palatine, Inverness, Hoffman Estates, Schaumburg, and the Northwest Chicago suburbs.

## 1-on-1 Physical Therapy — No Aides, No Double-Booking

Every session is conducted entirely by Dr. Julie Roy. Patients are never treated by aides or shared between therapists. Sessions are inside Tensile Strength Studio in Barrington, IL, with access to Pilates reformers, squat racks, free weights, and balance tools.

## Services

Orthopedic physical therapy for neck pain, back pain, shoulder injuries, hip pain, knee pain, and post-surgical rehab. TMJ and TMD therapy for jaw pain, clicking, locking, and related headaches. Trigger point dry needling, IASTM, cupping therapy, joint mobilization and manipulation. LSVT BIG certified neurologic rehabilitation for Parkinson's disease, stroke, and multiple sclerosis.

## Free Injury Consultation — No Referral Required

Illinois law permits direct access to physical therapy without a physician referral. New patients can book a free 20-minute injury consultation with no cost and no commitment.

## Pricing

Free injury consultation (20 min). Initial evaluation $180 (60 min). Recovery session $80 (30 min) or $150 (60 min). Packages of 6 or 10 visits: 5–10% off, never expire, shareable with family. HSA/FSA accepted. Superbills provided for out-of-network reimbursement.

## Hours and Contact

Phone: (847) 387-3610. Email: Julie@AchievePTWellness.com. Monday 7am–7pm; Tuesday–Thursday 8:30am–5pm; Friday 7am–5pm; Saturday–Sunday by appointment.

## Areas Served

Barrington, Lake Zurich, Palatine, Inverness, Hoffman Estates, Schaumburg, and the Northwest Chicago suburbs.

# 1-on-1 Physical Therapy in Barrington, IL

Physical therapy that actually listens and gets to the root cause.

At Achieve Physical Therapy, you're not a number. You're not sharing your therapist with three other patients. Every visit is 1-on-1 with Dr. Julie Johlie Roy, DPT who listens first, finds the root cause, and builds a plan around your goals. Whether you're dealing with a nagging injury, recovering from surgery, or not sure where to start we meet you where you are.

Is This You?

## You might be a great fit for Achieve PT if:

- ✓You've tried PT before and it felt generic or rushed
- ✓You're dealing with pain that hasn't fully resolved
- ✓You want someone to explain the why — not just hand you a sheet of exercises
- ✓You're active and want to get back to training, sport, golf, Pilates, or hiking
- ✓You're recovering from surgery and want a clear, progressive plan
- ✓You have jaw pain, headaches, or clicking your dentist can't explain
- ✓You or a loved one is living with Parkinson's, stroke recovery, or MS

**We're not a passive, go-through-the-motions practice.**

Recovery takes partnership — and we'll coach and encourage you every step of the way. If you want someone who listens, explains everything, and genuinely invests in your progress, you're in the right place.

### Not sure where to start?

Our free 20-minute injury consultation is exactly for this. No forms. No commitment. Just a conversation about what's going on and how we can help.

## Physical Therapy in Barrington, IL

Achieve Physical Therapy & Wellness is a private physical therapy practice at 756 W Northwest Highway, Suite B, Barrington, Illinois 60010, operated by Dr. Julie Johlie Roy, DPT. Serving Barrington, Lake Zurich, Palatine, Inverness, Hoffman Estates, Schaumburg, and the Northwest Chicago suburbs.

## 1-on-1 Physical Therapy — No Aides, No Double-Booking

Every session is conducted entirely by Dr. Julie Roy. Patients are never treated by aides or shared between therapists. Sessions are inside Tensile Strength Studio in Barrington, IL, with access to Pilates reformers, squat racks, free weights, and balance tools.

## Services

Orthopedic physical therapy for neck pain, back pain, shoulder injuries, hip pain, knee pain, and post-surgical rehab. TMJ and TMD therapy for jaw pain, clicking, locking, and related headaches. Trigger point dry needling, IASTM, cupping therapy, joint mobilization and manipulation. LSVT BIG certified neurologic rehabilitation for Parkinson's disease, stroke, and multiple sclerosis.

## Free Injury Consultation — No Referral Required

Illinois law permits direct access to physical therapy without a physician referral. New patients can book a free 20-minute injury consultation with no cost and no commitment.

## Pricing

Free injury consultation (20 min). Initial evaluation $180 (60 min). Recovery session $80 (30 min) or $150 (60 min). Packages of 6 or 10 visits: 5–10% off, never expire, shareable with family. HSA/FSA accepted. Superbills provided for out-of-network reimbursement.

## Hours and Contact

Phone: (847) 387-3610. Email: Julie@AchievePTWellness.com. Monday 7am–7pm; Tuesday–Thursday 8:30am–5pm; Friday 7am–5pm; Saturday–Sunday by appointment.

## Areas Served

Barrington, Lake Zurich, Palatine, Inverness, Hoffman Estates, Schaumburg, and the Northwest Chicago suburbs.
